sloka: मम हीक्ष्वाकवः पूज्याः परं पूज्यतमास्तव ।कुरु साचिव्यमस्माकं न नः कार्यमतिक्रमेत् ॥५-१-९७॥
transliteration: mama hīkṣvākavaḥ pūjyāḥ paraṁ pūjyatamāstava ।kuru sācivyamasmākaṁ na naḥ kāryamatikramet ॥5-1-97॥

translations.english: "You may act as our minister and let us not miss this chance. Pious men lose their cool if a worthy act is left unfulfilled.
